title: YeastVar1011: evidence-linked study design and quality control for yeast single-cell research
description: YeastVar1011 connects yeast single-cell study questions to source-attributed marker evidence, analysis methods, input requirements and documented research plans. Its browser workstation covers quality control, cell-state annotation, expression variation, RNA dynamics, regulation, population genetics and evolution. Plans retain method choices, dependency links, parameters and references, with document, spreadsheet, diagram and JSON exports. A separate Linux x86_64 Snakemake workflow processes libraries with an explicitly configured fixed contiguous cell barcode and UMI in a dedicated barcode read. It runs FastQC, STARsolo, samtools and MultiQC, retaining tagged BAM, Gene/GeneFull/SJ/Velocyto matrices and per-barcode QC. SLURM execution uses a site-configured profile. Version 22.1.1 standardizes the scientific description, citation metadata, licensing and reproducible source packaging while retaining the current catalogue and planning interface.
